archetype: Archetype 7: Electric & Neon (Adapted for Premium Tactical Dashboard)

design_philosophy.fusion: Mixing high-speed elite trading UI with minimalist sneaker-drop aesthetics. Deep void blacks create the theater, neon accents provide the data triggers.
design_philosophy.emotion: Command-center focus. Users should feel like elite power sellers with full control over their stock.
design_philosophy.spacing: Generous interior padding within cards to let data breathe, but tight grids to maximize screen real estate on mobile.
design_philosophy.contrast: Using matte black backgrounds against stark white text and 1px vibrant neon accents. No muddy gray overlays.

Dashboard.description: The command center. High-density data grid.

Stock.layout: Vertical list with swipe actions or quick-tap decision badges.

Sourcing.description: Analyzer tool to determine if an item is worth buying.
Sourcing.layout: Form-first layout with instant animated results.
key_elements: Big Result display: ACHAT FORT (Green) / ACHETER (Blue) / NÉGOCIER (Orange) / IGNORE (Red)

Ventes.layout: Timeline list or grouped by month/brand.
key_elements: Average sell price per brand chart (Recharts with Neon Green line)

Mode Action.description: Focused to-do list for stock rotation.
key_elements: Categorized tasks: Delete, Drop Price, Repost, Relaunch
Status badges: Interested (Green), Negotiating (Orange), No Response (Red)

testing.requirements: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case based on role (e.g. data-testid='tab-dashboard', data-testid='sourcing-submit-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first responsive React app mimicking a native Expo feel.
Rely entirely on AsyncStorage for data persistence; no external backend is needed.
Use the layout provided in `screens` and `components` to structure Shadcn and Tailwind configurations.
Implement the glassmorphism bottom navigation as the primary routing mechanism.
Use Lucide-React icons extensively to maintain the premium dashboard feel.
Avoid standard generic fonts; incorporate Unbounded (Google Fonts) for display/headings and Manrope for body text.
Ensure all text inside badges has a minimum APCA contrast ratio; neon green text on dark green backgrounds should be tested.
Use provided images for the splash screen, dashboard textural background, and placeholder stock list images.
Use French language strictly across all screens.
Ensure the layout has enough bottom padding (`pb-24`) to account for the fixed bottom navigation tab bar.
